'''TAC 171''' was the designation given to a [[ISB TAC shuttle]] used by forces from [[ISB Tactical]] during the [[raid on the Axis safehouse]] at [[Tomkip Towers]] on [[Coruscant]].<ref name="WEK" /><ref name="Jedha, Kyber, Erso">{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}</ref>
